uniswapV4Extension.reason: Existing production V3/Router02 adapters cannot encode a V4 PoolKey or implement its unlock settlement. New typed adapter and separate acceptance are needed.

feeLayers.combinedPercentNotSimplyFlatSum: Hook exact-input buy taxes specified stock first, LP fee applies to the net pool amount; output service fee must be applied to actual output.

hookAuthority.creatorPayoutTakeover: Factory owner proposes and waits 14 days; existing creator can veto, imposing 180-day quiet; acceptance window 14 days. Changes payout rights only, not tax rates.
hookAuthority.exactInputBuyPartialFill: Rejected by V2 hook PartialFillRefused if taxed input not fully used.
hookAuthority.exactOutputSell: Rejected by base hook ExactOutputRefused. Start integration with exact-input only and test both directions.

requiredPlan.newAdapter: A dedicated V4 exact-input adapter implementing authenticated PoolManager unlockCallback, pinned PoolKey/hook and actual input/output balance deltas; no arbitrary calldata or arbitrary caller-selected hook.
invariantChecks: Only expected PoolManager may invoke unlockCallback; require one in-flight expected operation
Settle only the pinned input asset and take only the pinned output asset; no arbitrary currency callback destinations
Validate pool ID matches keccak256(abi.encode(PoolKey)); static fee and tickSpacing plus hook codehash pinned
Fee accounting uses actual output; slippage/deadline bind to proof-authorized recipient and asset
Do not mark V4 hook tax as ERC20 fee-on-transfer; raw token transfer is plain ERC20
Validate SPCX issuer paused/blocklist status including PoolManager, route adapter, both privacy pools and recipient; surface freeze as external asset risk
Fork test both directions, minimum output, hook 1% tax, LP fee, 30bps treasury payment, partial-fill rejection, callback spoofing and full revert on failure
Both pools, indexer, ASP, relays, fee pricing and frontend route schema must be extended together before private-to-private release
